title: DentAI: an AI front desk for dental clinics
summary: A chat assistant and clinic dashboard that answers routine patient questions and books appointments on Telegram and the web.

brief.problem: Dental clinics in Malaysia still handle appointments, patient questions and staff messages by hand at the front desk. This creates bottlenecks and uneven patient experiences in busy periods, and reminder calls are the first task dropped.
brief.goal: Build one system that answers routine questions from clinic-owned data and refuses diagnostic questions, enforces booking rules in the database, shows the right media for a procedure, and sends confirmations and reminders without staff effort.

mine: Sole developer of this Final Year Project: research, design, build, testing and the written report.
Designed the AI agent, the database rules and the role-based dashboard.

process.text: Mapped the front-desk workflow and set five measurable objectives: a guarded AI agent, role-based dashboard, valid scheduling, contextual media and automatic notifications.
Answers come from clinic data, not the model's general knowledge. Scheduling rules live in the database, so no booking can fall outside opening hours, a dentist's shift or a break.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation served through n8n webhooks and OpenAI, with a Supabase PostgreSQL vector database. A React and TypeScript dashboard with row-level security, and serverless edge functions for media matching and notification dispatch.
Automated tests, manual scenarios for four user roles, live Telegram and Gmail runs, and a regression harness that replays questions from a Google Sheet against the live agent.
